title: nassella pfisteri
intro: Nassella pfisteri, commonly known as the Pfister's needle grass, is a species of grass native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Nassella pfisteri include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
